 Tio Pepe Festival 
 Fangoria at Tio Pepe Festival 2027: 31 July in Jerez with “La verdad o la imaginación”, tickets from €59
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Pau 
 21 Nov 2026, 09:30 
 A 2-minute read 
 Barcex / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Fangoria will play Tio Pepe Festival on Saturday 31 July 2027 , at the Las Copas bodega in Jerez, with doors at 20:00 and the concert at 22:15, to present “La verdad o la imaginación”. 
 Tickets are already on sale from €59 for the standing floor, plus booking fees; Front Stage costs €75 and seated stand tickets are between €65 and €68. 
 It is the fourth name announced for Tio Pepe Festival 2027 , after Raule (9 July), Luis Fonsi (10 July) and Los Secretos (6 August). 
 That same night, Alejandro Sanz closes his tour in Chiclana , so the province of Cádiz will host two major concerts on 31 July. 
 Fangoria are taking their new album to Jerez de la Frontera. The duo of Alaska and Nacho Canut will perform on Saturday 31 July 2027 at Tio Pepe Festival , the concert series that González Byass organises every summer at its bodegas, with “La verdad o la imaginación” , the album they introduced with the single “Me voy”. Tickets are already on sale.
 Festival guide 
 Tio Pepe Festival 2027 
 Dates to be confirmed · Bodega Tio Pepe Las Copas (González Byass), Jerez de la Frontera 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Fangoria at Tio Pepe Festival 2027: date, time and venue
 According to the official concert listing on Veranea en la Bodega, the series’ brand, these are the details:
 Date: Saturday 31 July 2027.
 Doors: from 20:00.
 Concert: at 22:15.
 Venue: Tio Pepe Las Copas bodega, in Jerez de la Frontera (Cádiz).
 The organisers point out that the ticket includes a visit to the Las Copas bodega, which must be requested on arrival. Minors need an authorisation form, and children under 3 are not admitted.
 Alaska, with Fangoria, at Madrid’s San Isidro festivities in May 2026. Image: Barcex / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0). Tickets for Fangoria in Jerez: prices by area
 The official sale is through Veranea en la Bodega , which links to Tickentradas . As of 20 November, all areas were shown as available at these prices, with booking fees added at purchase:
 Floor , standing and unreserved: €59.
 Stand , seated with access via stairs: €68 in stand 1 and €65 in stands 2 and 3.
 Front Stage , standing, next to the stage: €75.
 Terraza Croft Twist , with a chair or stool and a welcome drink: €90.
 Boxes , sold whole for six people, with a cocktail and a welcome drink: €115 per person.
 There are tickets for people with reduced mobility at €59. Only one category can be chosen per purchase, and no exchanges or refunds are accepted.
 The Tio Pepe Festival 2027 line-up so far
 Fangoria are the fourth concert announced for the thirteenth edition of Veranea en la Bodega. In date order, the series stands as follows:
 Friday 9 July: Raule , who opens the season in his home city.
 Saturday 10 July: Luis Fonsi.
 Saturday 31 July: Fangoria.
 Friday 6 August: Los Secretos.
 We covered the Fonsi and Los Secretos announcements in this week’s Tio Pepe Festival 2027 news story , and the rest of the practical information is in the Tio Pepe Festival guide . The series has not yet said how many nights it will have or when it ends.
 31 July: two major concerts in Cádiz
 Fangoria’s night coincides with the end of the Spanish tour by Alejandro Sanz , who plays on Saturday 31 July at Concert Music Festival in Sancti Petri, Chiclana de la Frontera. His concert, announced on Friday 20 November, goes on sale on Tuesday 24 November, and his other festival dates are in our story on Alejandro Sanz at the 2027 festivals .
 Sources: concert listing on veraneaenlabodega.com and Tickentradas sales page (prices and conditions), consulted on 20 November 2026; Cadena SER Radio Jerez and La Voz del Sur (20 November 2026); ModoFestival’s Tio Pepe Festival guide.
